title: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE)
hints: Pair feature i with feature i + d/2 (the half-split layout), not with feature i + 1.
theta_i = base^(-2i/d) for i in 0..d/2-1, and the angle is positions[:, None] * theta[None, :], shape (T, d/2).
Rotate each pair counterclockwise: (x1 cos - x2 sin, x2 cos + x1 sin). The (T, d/2) cos and sin broadcast over the leading axes of x.
